## Episode Thesis

The episode is a post-election interview with former Swedish finance minister Anders Borg about the 2026 Swedish general election. He argues that the result is much more even than feared and gives no mandate for a sharp left turn, a wealth tax or capital flight. He calls it a calming outcome for markets, the krona and Swedish public finances, and says Sweden looks relatively strong on its low government debt and on growth running above real interest rates. The hosts note that Swedish banks rose against the market trend despite the bank-tax debate, and that the Stockholm exchange ended up in positive territory. Apart from the banks as a sector, no individual listed stocks are discussed, and the named companies appear only as advertisers or media outlets.
